Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used iTRAQ 8-plex labeling with DDA acquisition on a Q-Exactive instrument. High abundance proteins were depleted using ProteoMiner. While the study focuses on the coagulation cascade and complement system, these were identified via bioinformatic enrichment (KEGG/GO) rather than physical PTM enrichment (like phospho or glyco), so no PTM modifier is applied.

scope: Blood samples for proteomics and metabolomics were collected in EDTA tubes and centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
To reduce the complexity of samples, the highly abundant proteins were depleted using ProteoMinerTM Kits (Bio-Rad) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on blood-derived samples. While high-abundance proteins were depleted using ProteoMiner, this is a common preprocessing step for total plasma/serum proteomics and does not constitute the isolation of a specific protein complex or subcellular organelle. Therefore, it is classified as whole cell lysate (representing the bulk proteome of the analyzed fluid).
